name: cloudflare_get_dns_record
description: Get a single DNS record by id. Returns {id, type, name, content, ttl, proxied, priority, comment, ...}. Requires `zone_id` and `record_id` (both from cloudflare_list_dns_records). Use this to confirm exactly what a record holds before updating or deleting it.

zone_id.description: The zone id the record belongs to.

record_id.description: The DNS record id to fetch.
